key_insight: Data-driven kriging and neural-network models can predict pressure loss across perforated plates more accurately than standard empirical correlations in turbulent flow.
engineering_relevance: These models offer a practical way to improve pressure-drop estimates in CFD and perforated-plate design when experimental data are sparse.
method: Trained on two literature experimental datasets for circular perforated plates.
Built and compared kriging and neural network predictors against common empirical formulas.
Embedded the new pressure-loss models as momentum source terms in 2D RANS channel-flow simulations.
evidence_signal: Across the available experimental configurations, both data-driven models generally matched measurements well and outperformed the widely used empirical models.
watch_item: The approach may be limited by the small amount of training data available, so extrapolation to unseen plate geometries or flow conditions should be used cautiously.
paper_title: Kriging and neural network models for pressure losses across perforated plates
